title: IntelEngine — NPC Autonomy & Faction Politics
tagline: Give Skyrim’s NPCs agency—tasks, schedules, autonomous stories, and faction politics.
description:
IntelEngine gives Skyrim's NPCs the ability to act autonomously through SkyrimNet. NPCs can travel, deliver messages, fetch or escort people, schedule meetings and tasks, spread gossip, pursue personal storylines, and participate in an evolving faction-politics system.

Originally created by **Galanx**. **PhospheneOverdrive** currently maintains it in the official galanx repositories (IntelEngine-GamePlugin and IntelEngine-NativePlugin), with Galanx's go-ahead.

Release **3.6** protects saved NPC names and memories, keeps names from name mods (such as RNE) across saves, **re-enables Skyrim VR** with one shared SE/AE/VR DLL, fixes Story DM candidate handling, and includes an offline save converter. **3.6.2** fixes couriers sometimes arriving twice, lets the converter handle saves it used to refuse, keeps the dashboard hotkey to Skyrim's window, applies hotkey changes from the SkyrimNet settings page without a restart, and keeps politics settings across saves. Windows Defender may still flag the bundled converter as a false positive; it is being reported to Microsoft.

⚠️ **Upgrading from a pre-3.6 save? Convert it before loading with 3.6.x.** Fresh games and saves already on 3.6.0 don't need conversion. See the FAQ included in the download for instructions.

Tested on **Skyrim SE/AE 1.6.1170 and 1.7.104** with SkyrimNet Beta 28. **VR 1.4.15 should work (partly tested).** Skyrim 1.5.97 is untested. Use the matching versions of **SKSE and Address Library**.

**Have issues?** Report them on the IntelEngine-GamePlugin GitHub issues page.

**Requires SkyrimNet Beta 25 or newer. Not compatible with Beta 24 or earlier.**
author: phospheneoverdrive
changelog:
### Save converter
- Converts saves that the 3.5.x→3.6 converter used to refuse: caches on temporary (FF) actors and leftover global caches are now converted in place.
- Refuses saves that are already converted (for example a later save made from an `_IEconverted` one) instead of double-encoding them.
- Clearer, multi-line output, plus a warning not to load converted saves with any IE 3.5.x.

### Couriers and quests
- Fixed couriers sometimes "arriving" twice, which injected duplicate/blank facts and caused errors after the quest ended.
- Cancelling a quest from the dashboard after the courier arrives now frees the courier properly.
- Courier story facts are recorded when the courier actually arrives, so an aborted courier leaves no facts behind.

### Dashboard hotkey
- Only works while Skyrim is focused, and modifiers must match exactly (a plain 7 no longer fires on Shift+7).
- Changing the hotkey on the SkyrimNet settings page now applies as soon as you click Save, no restart. The dashboard's Settings tab also changes it. Default: Shift+7.

### Other
- Politics settings now persist correctly, and politics can be turned on later without a restart.
- Story DM prompt: knowledge every candidate shares is listed once instead of repeated per NPC.
- Long text is truncated on UTF-8 character boundaries.
- Removed unused internal functions.

This release updates `IntelEngine.dll` and several scripts that must match it; install the whole package over the previous version.

**Antivirus note:** Microsoft Defender may flag the bundled save converter `LegacyCacheMigration.exe` (`Wacapew.C!ml`, a machine-learning heuristic, 1/70 on VirusTotal). It is a false positive and is being reported to Microsoft. The converter is only needed to upgrade 3.5.x saves.

Full changelog: https://github.com/galanx/IntelEngine-GamePlugin/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v362
Download: https://github.com/galanx/IntelEngine-GamePlugin/releases/tag/v3.6.2
